description: Choose how to find jobs: paste one or more Workday careers-site URLs (mode=careerSite), name a tenant and its site (mode=tenant), or paste direct job URLs (mode=jobDetail). One of startUrls or tenant + site is required. Then filter by keyword, location, job family, posting date or remote work.

includeJobFamily.description: Add each job's family or category (for example Engineering or Sales). This uses the site's own Job Category filter and is skipped automatically when a site has no such filter.
includeJobFamily.title: Include Job Family

jobFamilies.description: Optional job families or categories to keep, for example 'Engineering', 'Sales' or 'Finance'. Names come from the site's own Job Category filter; IDs are also accepted.
jobFamilies.title: Job Families

locations.description: Optional locations to keep. Use names such as 'United States', 'New York', 'Remote' or 'US, CA, Santa Clara'; the actor matches them against the site's own location filters. Facet IDs are also accepted.
locations.title: Locations

maxItems.description: Maximum number of jobs to save across all URLs. Jobs are returned in URL order, so a large first site can use the whole cap.
maxItems.title: Max Items

mode.description: How to find jobs. 'Scrape career site URLs' accepts careers pages or job URLs. 'Scrape a tenant by name' uses tenant + site. 'Scrape specific job URLs' requires /job/... URLs in startUrls.
mode.title: Mode

postedAfter.description: Optional exact cutoff date in YYYY-MM-DD form. When both Posted Within and Posted After are set, the stricter cutoff wins.
postedAfter.title: Posted After

postedWithin.description: Keep jobs posted within this window. 'Any time' applies no date filter. Use Posted After for an exact cutoff date.
postedWithin.title: Posted Within

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The actor works without a proxy and chooses a working connection automatically; change this only if you need a specific proxy setup.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

region.description: Workday data-center region. Leave 'auto' to detect it, or set wd1, wd3, wd5, wd12, wd103, and similar when you already know it (mode=tenant).
region.title: Workday Region

remoteOnly.description: Keep only postings the employer explicitly marks as remote. Hybrid and onsite postings are excluded. This turns on full detail fetching.
remoteOnly.title: Remote Jobs Only

scrapeDetails.description: Fetch each posting's public job page for the full description, exact posting date, employment type, work model and every location. Turn off for a fast listing-only run (title, location, requisition ID, posting label and URL). Direct job URLs always fetch details because a listing has no record for them.
scrapeDetails.title: Include Full Job Details

searchText.description: Optional keyword passed to the site's own job search, for example 'engineer' or 'marketing'. Workday searches titles and descriptions.
searchText.title: Search Keyword

site.description: Optional career site identifier shown in the URL after the tenant host, for example 'NVIDIAExternalCareerSite' or 'External_Career_Site' (mode=tenant). It is case-sensitive. Leave blank to discover the tenant's first public site automatically.
site.title: Career Site ID

startDateFrom.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD cutoff for the role's start date. Only applies when the posting publishes a start date. This turns on full detail fetching.
startDateFrom.title: Start Date From

startUrls.description: Public Workday careers-site or job URLs (mode=careerSite or jobDetail). Paste the URL from your browser; both myworkdayjobs.com and myworkdaysite.com are supported. In careerSite mode a careers URL scrapes the site's jobs and a /job/... URL scrapes that single posting; in jobDetail mode use a /job/... URL.
startUrls.title: Workday Careers URLs

tenant.description: Workday tenant name, for example 'nvidia' or 'capitalone' (mode=tenant). You can also paste the full careers URL here or use 'tenant/site'. When the site ID is omitted, the actor finds the tenant's first public site automatically.
tenant.title: Tenant

title: Workday Careers Site Job Listings Extractor Input
